en: A vintage black and white postcard image of a street scene in front of a church-related building complex. There are several buildings with traditional architecture, one with a small bell tower. Some people can be seen, including a cyclist riding in the foreground, and a few pedestrians. The overall setting appears organized and peaceful, with gardens or green spaces enclosed by low railings. Overhead, 'Torgau a. Elbe. Kath. Pfarrhaus mit Kommunikanten-Anstalt.' is printed in German.
